semiconductor_relevance: High — Lian Shi New Material Corp. specializes in ultra-high purity electronic chemical application materials critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Founded in 2017, Lian Shi New Materials (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. produces and sells ultra-high purity electronic chemicals, including electronic-grade sulfuric acid, ammonia, hydrofluoric acid, and nitric acid. The company primarily serves major domestic integrated circuit manufacturers, leveraging its proprietary purification technologies.
capabilities: Manufacturing of ammonia and hydrofluoric acid
Development of high-purity electronic chemical processes

regional_presence.China: The company primarily serves major domestic 8-12 inch integrated circuit manufacturers.
